basic_details.job_title: RailTel Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for JGM / SR DGM Posts
basic_details.short_information: RailTel Corporation of India Limited (RCIL), a Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Railways, invites applications on a deputation basis from IRSSE and Gazetted S&T Officers for 1 post of Joint General Manager (JGM) / Senior Deputy General Manager (Sr. DGM) (E6/E5) for the Northern Region. Eligible candidates must forward their applications through the proper channel to Corporate Office/RCIL, Plate-A, 6th Floor, Office Block, Tower-2, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023 within 30 days from date of notification (about 21 November 2026).

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days from date of notification (about about 21 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates may apply through the proper channel for selection on deputation/absorption basis to the vacancies in the prescribed proforma available on the official website at www.railtel.in. Zonal Railways, etc., may forward the applications of eligible candidates along with complete biodata indicating previous postings and a statement giving details of any previous deputation(s) in Central PSUs, duly signed by the applicant. Applications should also include vigilance/DAR clearance and copies of APARs for the last five years. Applications should be sent to: Corporate Office/RCIL, Plate-A, 6th Floor, Office Block, Tower-2, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023. Applications of Indian Railway officers may be forwarded to the Railway Board. Applications received without enclosures will not be entertained. All eligible SC/ST/OBC officers may also be advised to apply. Contact Details: Tel: +91 11 22900600, Fax: +91 11 22900699, Website: www.railtelindia.com / www.railtel.in.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted for 1 post of JGM / SR DGM (E6/E5) on a deputation basis. The appointment duration is three years or until RCIL is exempted from the rule of immediate absorption, whichever is earlier. Service: IRSSE / Gazetted S&T Officers (Deputation: Group-A IRSSE Services). Minimum Eligibility Conditions for JGM: JAG (Level 12) with 10 years of Group A service. Minimum Eligibility Conditions for Sr. DGM: JAG (Level 12) or Sr. Scale (Level 11) with 8 years of gazetted service. Educational Qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should refer to the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility requirements. Age Limit: SAG officer should not exceed 58 years on the closing date of receipt of application and below SAG level officer should not exceed 56 years on the closing date of receipt of application. Cut-off Date: The cut-off date for age and eligibility is reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of application. Pay Scale: Parent grade pay plus deputation allowance as per rules (on deputation). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: RCIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: KAVACH project of West Central Railway (WCR) for coordination with Railways. Day-to-day project execution monitoring. Smooth implementation of the project. Coordination and resolution of project-related issues with Railways.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed proforma. Candidate biodata indicating previous postings. Statement giving details of any previous deputation(s) in Central PSUs, duly signed by the applicant. Vigilance/DAR clearance. Copies of APARs for the last five years.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under RCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of JGM / SR DGM (E6/E5) on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must reach through proper channel within 30 days from date of notification (about 21 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JGM / Sr. DGM post?
faq.answer: An SAG officer should not exceed 58 years on the closing date of receipt of application, and a below SAG level officer should not exceed 56 years.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the JGM post in RCIL?
faq.answer: Officers must belong to Group-A IRSSE services holding JAG (Level 12) with 10 years of Group A service.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Sr. DGM post in RCIL?
faq.answer: Officers must belong to Group-A IRSSE services holding JAG (Level 12) or Senior Scale (Level 11) with 8 years of gazetted service.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for this deputation vacancy?
faq.answer: The appointed officer will draw their parent grade pay plus deputation allowance as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the period of appointment for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The appointment on deputation is for three years or until RCIL is exempted from the rule of immediate absorption, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected officer be posted?
faq.answer: The designated place of posting is in the Northern Region.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose their biodata of past postings, signed statement of previous Central PSU deputations, vigilance/DAR clearance, and APAR copies for the last 5 years.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded through the proper channel to Corporate Office/RCIL, Plate-A, 6th Floor, Office Block, Tower-2, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023.
